user.title: Connect to NEIS
user.description: An API key is optional, but requests without one are limited to the first five sample rows and ignore pagination. A six-period timetable can therefore lose period 6. [Request a free API key]({api_key_url}) or acknowledge limited mode.

data.limited_ack: I understand that data can be incomplete without an API key

school.title: Find a school
school.description: Choose an education office and enter part or all of the school name.

class.title: Select a class
class.description: With an API key, available classes are listed automatically. Limited mode validates the class you enter.

error.api_error: NEIS rejected the request. Check the API key and input.
error.class_not_found: The selected grade and class were not found.
error.incomplete_data: NEIS returned incomplete sample data. Add an API key and try again.
error.limited_not_acknowledged: Acknowledge the limitation or enter an API key.
